system.description:
Deal [(SR)D + (Magic Power)] magical damage to the target.

(Effect): Give direct damage of [INT Mod × SR] as extra damage, to "What is present in all Sq specified at the time of selection of this skill (indiscriminate)" in the Cleanup Process of this round. 

An offensive magic that activates the magic of the earth and creates explosive flames like a volcanic eruption. The flames soar to the heavens and then fall back down to the earth, turning the surrounding area into scorched earth.
